title: Kicked Up Middle Eastern Chicken Tagine
description: A fresh and snappy Middle Eastern dish featuring chicken, castelvetrano olives, and puff pastry, made in a traditional tagine pot and suitable for a sick day.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large square.
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, onion, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, and olives.
Place the chicken mixture in the center of the pastry square, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little water, then fold the pastry over the filling to form a triangle.
Place the tagine pot in the oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and add the chicken broth.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through.
